reviews.comment: Such a funny guy and you can tell he cares about his students the way he talks in lecture. The tests were difficult, but he gives practice exams that have very similar content to the exams. This class requires work, but it's good to know that he has your back.

Dr. Xie is very nice and helpful but the exams were pretty difficult so study well in advance. He offers a decent amount of extra credit and is available to meet with outside of the class. I would recommend for bio 112.

He is a very nice, but not the best lecturer. His accent is quite heavy, and he mostly just reads straight from the slides without much further explanation. You basically have to teach yourself the material outside of class. He offers some extra credit, and passing the class is possible if you put in the effort on your own.

LOVE THIS MAN!! he cares so much and he's pretty funny. he would extra credit even if we didn't meet the class criteria for it (survey particiaption) and his exams are pretty straight forward. the class is just content heavy so def study in advance. iclicker can be done from anyone. some exam q come from his problems set and practice exams.

He is sweet. He wants you to do well. Some people say his class is boring but idk what you expect him to do...dance? The subject itself is just so boring. His exams are easy if you study. I personally liked the way he had a little map of the content like an overview in his slides. It would also tell you where in that overview he is explaining.

Straightforward exams and homeworks. He gives extra credit through i-Clicker and from class participation in surveys throughout the semester. Lectures can be a little boring, but as long as you read through the slides and pay attention to the learning objectives you'll do well.

One of the best professors I've had so far! The extra credit given could definitely make the difference between letter grades. The hardest part of the class was the lab, and the lab did move faster than the lecture most of the time. Some of the examples in the lectures were on the exams, so pay attention in class. Textbook not needed to pass.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr.Xie was AMAZING he only has 1 ten question quiz due per week and gives extra credit alot the exams were pretty simple and lab was very easy. Please take him not only for your sanity but for your GPA too.

I enjoyed being in Dr. Xie's class. He tried his best to keep his lectures enjoyable with the added memes and jokes. Often had easy iClicker participation points and tried his best in different ways to make his students understand the content. I would take him as my professor again if given the option. He was amazing.

Such a kind and funny professor, I admire Dr. Xie both as an instructor and human being. He is caring and always wants to help. Lectures are necessary to receive an A because the exam questions are not always based on what's on the slides. Lots of extra credit available (~23 points total). Def go to SI to reinforce topics, our SI this sem was good!

You can tell Xie genuinely cares about all his students and wants them all to succeed. He made the class so easy and reached out to students to help. He offers 22.5 points of extra credit. The exams were super easy and totally manageable!

I loved Dr. Xie. He made class so easy. I barely studied for most exams and ended up with a B. He is hilarious! I hated 111, but Xie made me love taking bio again. He doesn't give out a lot of homework assignments, but when he does they are easy and helpful. He gives out practice exams, which are pretty similar to the actual exams.
Great prof!! Super nice and he genuinely wants you to pass!

Easy exams, easy extra credits, easy homeworks. Best professor I had my freshman year by far. Very accessible out of class. Lab exams are harder than the lecture exams. I took him for BIOL111 too and he is a very good professor for anyone interested in biology topics outside of course materials, or just grades too.

Overall, Xie Runshi is probably one of the best professors you can get for Biology 112. He does have a foreign accent, which can make it a little hard to focus at times during his lectures, but his slides are VERY useful. All of his exam material is from his slides, and he does I-clickers in class that are good practice for his exams.
great prof take him it is almost a guaranteed b if u don't go to class but study slides

Professor Xie is such an amazing person and teacher! He does go over the lecture slides pretty quick, so it's recommended to go over the slides the day before class. Biology isn't my favorite, but he really cares about everyone and makes sure to make lectures interesting. Do all of the homeworks and make sure to study for the test a week prior.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Xie is an amazing professor! He's got some good jokes and is a very sweet guy. His exams were super easy too, in my opinion. They were all just like the practice exams and problem sets, super straight forward. This class is veryyyy memory-based, but an easy A if you take the time to memorize all the content which is all on the slides.

Dr. Xie is an amazing professor! He's got some good jokes and seems like a very sweet guy. His exams were also super easy in my opinion. They were just like the practice quizzes and problems sets, very straight forward. This class is veryyyy memory-based, but an easy A if you take time memorize all the content which is all on the slides.
Best professor I've had so far!!!

I didn't go to the last month of class but still ended with an A. Everything you need to know is on the slides and Dr. Xie just reads off of them. It's a lot of content, but exams are often just like the practice exams. There's also not much homework. Not a bad class!
Best prof I've taken so far. This class is very heavy on memorization but not hard to learn, prof Xie explains everything in detail and WANTS you to do good. Take his class.
Show up and pay attention it will be an easy A, if you show up, dont pay attention, and study night before the test it will be an easy B

Xie held optional group study hours the day before exams and answered any questions, & gave extra credit for surveys throughout the sem on exam grades! Funny & engaging lectures and topics weren't hard at all. Obviously study but if you study last min I think you'd still do fine.

Professor was really great!He taught the class with heavy lecture material but he makes jokes along the way.He was very good at teaching the material and is not too hard to do good in this class.Just understanding the lecture slides to do good in the class.He also gives 20 extra points of extra credit.Would 100% take again

He is such a bright prof that makes learning biology so much more fun! Provides so much iClicker and extra credit that really boosts your grade. Take him if you have the chance, super accessible in office hours too if you have any questions!!

Dr. Xie is super sweet and I really enjoyed his lectures! Attendance isn't required, but he gives extra credit for the IClicker questions done in class. His exams are pretty easy if you study the problem sets and practice exams he provides. He also brought everyone candy and stickers a couple of times through the semester!
This man was amazing! If you have a chance to take him, I 100% would recommend it! His practice exams are so helpful and his test are easy!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Xie was my favorite professor this semester! He is amazing. He is a great lecturer, and I felt that he presented the course's content in a way that was easy to understand. The course's workload was quite reasonable, and I never felt stressed about this course. The tests were also easy. If you put in the effort, you will easily pass this class.

Very big on lectures. Lectures can get boring, however, he does have extra credit for showing up to class. Easily accessible outside of class and is very nice. Make sure to understand the material, not just memorize it. He did curve some tests and gave points back if the class did bad.

Such a sweet guy!! He genuinely cares about his students and offers up to 20 pts extra credit. He has practice test (unlimited attempts) that help with the tests. He likes to do demonstrations in class and tries to keep the class engaged.
Dr. Xie is great! If you are thinking about taking him, do it! His tests are substantially easier than other professors. He gives extra credit for going to class, so please go to class.

Kind, sweet, adorable, funny man. He makes up for lectures that are hard to stay awake/pay attention to by offering so many resources and extra credit. Tests were all multiple choice and similar to hw/practice exams/iClicker questions. Study for exams early. You will have to self teach a lot.

Fun guy and engaging in lectures. Posts all lecture material and attendance isn't mandatory but you get like 5 full grade points of extra credit from Iclicker attendance so you should still go. Exams are fine as long as you study. Overall, good pick for a boring class like bio 111

He's a very nice guy and the exams are easy. My one complaint is that sometimes his slideshows didn't make any sense, and didn't have enough information on them in order to actually understand what he's saying. Best thing to do is try to teach yourself the content before each class so it's not completely new info during the lectures.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Xie is a super nice guy and always wanted to help our class. BIO 111 is just a boring topic for me so lectures were boring, but the SI sessions helped me a lot. He also always reached out to us offering help in office hours, which was super nice. Exams were a bit difficult so just make sure to study a decent amount. Overall a great guy!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Xie was super sweet and gave lots of extra credit and three attempts for the practice exams/homework. I did not really learn much from his teaching style. It's a lot of just listening to him reading off the slides. Sometimes he would spice it up with an activity, which I always enjoyed. Overall, I enjoyed him and his class.

He offers extra credit through iclicker so do those. He offers study sessions before each exam and does practice exams on canvas. The problem sets and practice exams are helpful study material. All this being said, he does read off the slides so you will have to put in extra work on your own time but as long as you try, you will pass.

Sweet and caring. Gives out EC through iClicker which are basically participation. Tests are easy if you take time and do practice problems and his practice exams. Very accessible and will try to help. He is so cute and actively tries to make lectures better and funny. Best professor for BIOL111. You will NOT regret taking him.
i feel so maternal towards him he is so adorable and a great professor. exams are like the problem sets

I loved Dr. Xie he's really adorable and tries his best to make lectures interesting with his memes. He also hosts study sessions before exams and tries his best to revisit concepts that you have questions about. Attendance is encouraged but not mandatory since he does iclicker for EC. He's an understanding prof and he is always willing to help.

Overall great professor. Attendance is not mandatory and I clicker questions can be done at home. He is very helpful at office hours and will respond to emails quickly. His test are straightforward and the practice tests are very helpful. Would recommend.

He's very nice and chill, exams aren't bad uses a lot of questions from the review and not too tricky. He basically reads off the slides so definitely you have to study yourself a lot but problem sets and homework aren't bad in general. Lab assignments not bad as well. 1st lab exam was also online.
He is ok, but sometimes he did not clearly convey information and that caused me to do a lot of self-teaching for tests

Overall hes a good lecturer, sometimes they get long and boring but he throws in jokes here and there. his test arent bad at all, their straight forward, just make sure to start reviewing the week before and it helps to look through the textbook. Lab is probubly the worst part of this class.

Dr.Xie is a great professor. Lectures can be boring, but he does try to make them as interesting as possible. His tests aren't too hard; he has practice exams and problem sets that are pretty similar to the actual test. He does give out bonus points if you are present and participate in Iclicker. Overall, great guy and would take him again.

Hes so adorable so idk why people are hating. He's funny and uses props to explain things so i dont think he's boring at all. He wants the best for his students and you can tell! I'm taking the class right now and i have no doubt that i can make an A

Very good professor! Explains things so that you understand them and he is very chill, Just take notes on the slides in lecture and you should be good! He is also very understanding and kind. I took him for both bios and got A's in both!
His lectures were honestly very boring and hard to pay attention in. However, it's not hard to make a good grade in his class. Extra credit is offered, and his tests are pretty straightforward.

I took AP bio that helped a lot in 111 but not as much in 112, but was still useful. He was good, but boring at 8AM lol. I didn't go to the last month of class and did great. The final was lowkey hard but i didn't study AT ALL and still got a 78 on the exam. Ended with a 94 in the class or something like that. Easy so take him.

Dr. Xie was awesome, easy going, and kind. His lectures were good, but can get boring at times as biology does. Make sure to do the iClicker questions and attend lecture. The practice exams help a lot as do the learning intentions covered at the beginning of each slideshow! Bio isn't easy, but he makes it as easy as he can for students!

This was my second class with Dr. Xie and it was more challenging but only because of the content. His problem sets were super easy and most of the lecture exams came from the practice exams. His class is easier than most but above all he's a very kind and understanding prof. He cares for the well-being of his students and is funny. Take him!

Dr. Xie gives extra credit through iclicker and lots of exam questions are pulled from iclicker or problem sets. Only complaint is that his lectures are quite boring and its hard to pay attention but all the information that you need is on the slides.

He made bio so easy. I took this class with so many other hard classes and barely had to worry about it. I studied a day before the exams and did well. A lot of questions from practice exams and problem sets. His iclicker can be done from home (no location). He is super chill, and funny. People who say his accent is too strong are being ridiculous.

Not sure why his rating is so low. His class was WAY easier than 111. Everything on exams is on his slides. Most of his exam questions are pulled from iClicker, practice exams, or problem sets. He gave 23.5 extra credit points. His 8:00 lectures did make me fall asleep. Only needed 63% on iClicker for full credit. Worth going to class for exams.

I went to lecture like maybe 5 times the whole semester and got an A. Exams are super easy and are just the slides he posts. He reuses the practice exam questions on the actual exam (including final). The final exam included past test questions. The hardest exam (still easy) was just the final but that's just because there's a lot of content at end

Xie is a good professor. I think people dislike
him because the lectures are a little boring, but the content itself just isn't that fun. His exams are easy and very reflective of the slides. They also often include repeat questions from practice tests. Overall I recommend Xie!

Dr. Xie is an amazing professor who cares about his students. His exams are easy with a handful of repeat questions from homework sets and practice exams. The only downside to taking him is that his accent is thick so some things can be misunderstood during lecture. But for the sake of the grade in the class you can honestly get an A quite easily.

Super sweet professor. He cares about all of his students and will personally go out of his way to reach out if he notices you struggling which is nice because most professors won't care enough to. 20 points iclicker extra credit if you go to class which adds 2 points to your letter grade which is super helpful. Overall great professor!!

Lots of things to memorize but if you remember everything on his slides you will def get an A in his class. Lots of extra credit (+23.5 points), practice tests are very helpful for actual exams, and he is very nice and responds to emails fast. Reading the textbook can be beneficial but not necessary.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is a very nice professor, but I could not pay attention at all. He is very monotone and mostly just reads off the slides. BIOL 112 overall is just a very boring class. I mostly self-taught/studied for exams with the notes, which is enough to get A's on them.

I love this professor, it seems like he really cares about how you are doing. If you go to class for the extra credit, it's a game-changer. It adds around 2 extra points on your average which translates to around 20 points on one of your tests. His lectures are just off the slides but he does try to make it fun.

Such a sweet professor! He is very kind, and I would highly recommend taking him for BIOL 112. He includes funny pictures and memes in the lectures which make them entertaining to listen to. The exams are also very similar to the practice exam with some questions pulled from there as well. If I could, I would definitely take him again.

Xie is the best prof I have ever had. I took him for 111 and rearranged my entire schedule to have him for 112. He gives lots of easy homeworks (easy points) and his practice exams are exactly like the real test (he even pulls some of the same questions). 3 exams and a final. Go to class to get your iclicker's, they end up being bonus points.

I do not know why this professor is not rated higher. I took him for both Biology 111 and Biology 112, and he is a very sweet professor. He wants everyone to do well and sets up the assignments so that you are well prepared for the tests. Tests are similar to the practice exams and sometimes have replicate questions.

Xie is a very nice guy, and he tries his best to make the class engaging with memes and jokes. It can be hard to pay attention since the content is very boring, and he often reads off slides. Exams are generally easy and his practice exams are similar so you can study that.

He is a fine professor but he stutters very badly over his words and reads directly off the slides which makes it difficult to follow lectures. I have never been to his office hours but he seems like a nice guy and he doesn't make the tests harder than they have to be. It's just unfortunate that his lectures are the way they are.

He was a good prof. English is not his first language so he stuttered a lot but if that doesnt bother you thats chill. His lectures are a bit boring and he has iclicker every class but they are bonus. Take advantage of the practice exam and problem sets, half the test is similar questions

Dr Xie is awesome! Had him for both 111 and 112. He is one of the best professors I've had. He will give you all the resources you'll need to succeed in his class. Also, show up to his office hours if you struggled on an exam. He will sit down with you and tell you why you got the question wrong and how you can improve. Would highly recommend him!
Lectures were hard to follow at 8 AM. The class was easy, the practice exams prepare you for the exams. Offers extra credit through iClicker.

Not the worst but, I suggest finding another for Bio 111. The pacing was horrific, would spend the entire class on one subject and then use last ten minutes to skim through something very important. Nice guy but read off his slides. Practice exams and slides were basically what was on the exam so could teach yourself. Iclicker only reason to go.

He's genuinely so sweet! Tests are easy with a practice exam that is basically the exam. Problem sets are really easy with only 10 questions and the lab is pretty basic with better TA's than BIOL111 as well! HIGHLY RECOMMEND HIM!!!
Funny, sweet, VERY easy exams (literally takes half the exam from the practice exams he posts). Attendance not mandatory and honestly the extra credit you get from going is so minuscule.

best professor for biology 111 and 112!! had him for both and I can say he's a great professor who cares about what he teaches. Tests are easy if you put in the work, and assignments aren't that bad. Definitely recommend taking him if you struggle in any science classes.
he is so sweet and funny, he cares about the class and if you pay attention and do the work, you'll be fine.

Professor Xie is a super sweet and funny guy! Sometimes it was difficult to grasp the material because it was hard to pay attention. The exams have repeat questions from the practice exams so be sure to study them!! iClicker points were a lifesaver for me so go to class!! Make sure you have a little bit of an understanding of biology!

Dr. Xie is a very young but chill and caring professor. Exams are extremely similar to the practice exams and some even have repeat questions. Show up to class to get iClicker points by answering questions during lectures. Take him if you already have a robust understanding of biology, otherwise, take another prof for a deeper understanding.
was very hard to pay attention when getting off topic too much

Dr. Xie was such a kind professor. Although his lectures may not be engaging, he would try his best to convey the information efficiently. His exams were very similar to the powerpoint and practice exams so I would take advantage of those. He also has iclicker points for extra credit which helps boost your grade! I would recommend taking him!

Dr. Xie is a young prof so he is still figuring out the best methods to get content across to an audience of students. Because of this, his lectures mainly consisted of reading right off the slides. Iclicker points will help you as they helped me tremendously in his class. Funny cat memes in the slides.

He tried to make everyone laugh during his lectures and gave opportunities for extra credit through Iclicker, if you were in class during lecture. I highly recommend going to his class even though it wasn't 100% mandatory. He writes his slides well and there isn't much homework. The practice exams helped and the tests aren't written to trick you.

Xie is super sweet and you can tell he wants his students to do well. The material is difficult, but extra credit is offered through class attendance and he sometimes curves grades, usually not by much though. Study, study, study if you want to do well.

Very tough Prof. Very hard to understand, and his lectures are very boring because he reads off of slides. His accent makes it extremely hard to understand what he is saying. Would not take him again.

His lectures could get slightly boring but honestly he is a chill professor and makes the class super easy. Tests are pretty easy and the practice exam helps. 20 bonus Iclicker points if you show up and answer the questions. Take him if you just need to get your bio credit done but if you genuinely want to learn in depth maybe take someone else.

Least favorite professor out of all the professors I've taken this semester. The lectures were a bore & also hard to pay attention to. He went very fast and never really explained the material properly. He gave us no extra credit. In fact, he took away these “ accidental extra points” which boosted some of our grades by a few points 😞.

I took Xie fall 2024 and he was really good! All lecture slides are posted on Canvas and all exam material is directly from the slides! Attendance is not required, but he does iClicker for extra credit (study iClicker questions for tests), so I recommend going. The labs are also super easy and boring, but the lab reports are really tedious.

I loved Dr. Xie's class. Taking AP Bio prepared me for his class. He uses Iclicker as bonus points so attend class! There are 3 exams and none of them are dropped but the exams are almost exactly like the practice. He added a ton of jokes to keep things engaging and will go over topics or test questions students don't understand.

Don't let the 2/5 scare you, the class is very manageable if you have taken AP Bio or any other higher-level bio course. He gets a 2/5 from me for reading off the slides the whole class every class. Go for the iClicker points. Three tests and a final with similar reviews for each. Overall a nice guy. Strong accent but it never bothered me.

If you study the PowerPoints and memorize every point (which honestly isn't difficult), it's easy to get an A on exams. I showed up to class the first half of the semester and realized that the iclicker was just for extra points so I stopped going and still managed an A. His lectures are a bit difficult to get through though because of his accent.

Dr. Xie is a very sweet man, although sometimes his lectures were difficult to follow. He is helpful and willing to meet for office hours but be prepared to teach yourself the content. Go to class for iClicker extra credit! Exams were very similar to practice tests which is helpful.

Dropped the class due to how lecture heavy the class was. Not only that, but he would only mainly read off of slides and jump around from information. TA's were never really in class unless we had a test, and even with them their they weren't the nicest. Had to practically teach myself everything at the end of the day.

OK professor, he just reads off the slides. He does use iclicker a lot which really helps so even though attendance isn't mandatory I suggest not skipping class. He posts practice tests which are similar to the exam which is nice.
One of the best BIOL 111 teachers if you are not a BIO or BIMS major for sure.

Will be taking this professor for BIOL 112 as well. Lectures are easily digestible and has a lot of funny jokes throughout them. He reads all the feedback on iclicker and goes through questions/helps if people do not understand something. He grades fair and adds extra credit for iclicker participation in class.

Super nice guy but lectures are so boring I'm writing this in class. Reads off of the notes, offers extra credit for going to class, gives practice exams that are exactly like the exam with some of the same questions.  Exams are easy as long as you study the notes.

He was hated on by so many of my peers but I personally loved him. He was there when you needed him and a helpful guy outside of class. I took AP Biology in HS so this class was easy. He uses iClicker for extra credit for showing up to class and he has a lot of practice material for the exam.

I will be taking him again for BIOL 112.

He isn't a bad professor at all, he's actually quite knowledgeable and funny, but his lectures are mainly just reading off of the slides and aren't all that engaging. If you can understand his practice exams then you'll do fine on the real exams, they are quite similar.

You can tell he tries but man are his lectures really boring. Literally just reads off the slides, he posts them on Canvas so attendance is not mandatory, but it is if you want the iClicker bonus points (which help). 4 tests (including final), weekly lab quiz and problem set. Work load is not bad but the material is difficult and I had to selflearn

Dr. Xie is a very sweet professor. He really cares about his students. However, he pretty much just reads off of lecture slides. I like this because it meant that if I missed class, I could still easily catch up. However, 112 is very difficult with tons of memorization, so it made it a bit harder to learn. Nevertheless, he is awesome.

Yeah the lectures were a bit boring, but he tried his best to make you laugh or smile during them which helped. Gives practice exams that are really similar to actual exams, but would still recommend studying. Labs were very repetitive but easy too. One weekly assignment and offers 30 bonus points in iClicker participation.

Was a bit unclear on things in class and is very monotone (not fun when you have an 8 am lecture). You can tell he cares about his students and he wants people to succeed. Would add things to his lectures to try to make it interesting

He's lectures are so boring, all he does is read his slides and that's it. Attendance is mandatory so you do have to go to class. His practice exams are similar to his exam which is nice. Overall, he is nice and caring but you will most likely have to teach yourself the content.

Runshi is a very nice man and I have no doubt about his character. He is a new professor and it shows at times, sometimes reading the slides he repeats himself a couple times. He is also still learning english which hinders his teaching but that is hard to hold against him. He makes jokes and tries to make his class as interesting as possbile.

Dr.Xie is a really great professor, classes can get boring sometimes, but he really cares about his students and what he teaches. He gives out practice exams that are somewhat like the exam but not really. Studying is your best friend. Also gives out extra points based off IClicker questions and quizzes. Exams aren't very specific nor confusing.

He is a very good professor. I would say his test are just based off the slides so definitely recommend going to class. He gives extra credit points with I Clicker questions so beware of that. He reads off the slides but as long as you understand what is going on you will be fine. Great professor would recommend taking him for Biology 111 and 112.

This teacher is very nice and funny however he does read directly off the slides that he provides prior. He has iclicker bonus points which will definitely add up if you attend class. Tests are difficult but that is just the nature of biology. You will need to revisit your notes outside of class and reteach yourself at some points.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Really boring lecturer (monotone, heavy accent) but the exams are very similar to the practice exams. Doesn't replace or drop lowest exam score though so beware. As long as you study the slides you should be good for exams. Gives a lot of extra credit for iclicker so try not to miss class. Definitely geared towards self learning and memorization

Attendance isn't mandatory but recommended as he does iclickers that are super helpful in raising your grade. Exams come from his slides and they are easy compared to other professors, however studying is still very necessary to succeed.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class is so easy with him. You dont even really have to pay attention in lecture because he reads off the slides and what the slides say are exactly whats on the test. Take notes, do good in labs, and this is an easy A course

He's a really really nice guy, the class is designed really well, but he's just new and it shows. He WILL be good, but he just doesn't yet have the experience. His lectures aren't engaging, but clicker gives a lot of bonus. The exams are pretty easy and are very very VERY similar to practice exams.

Dr. Xie has trouble teaching difficult concepts. He does better with easier and memorization based material. He is very sweet and I think he will learn how to teach. Right now, however, he is not sufficient in teaching hard classes.

Dr. Xie is pretty bad at teaching. However, I think with his personality he will adjust to learning how to demand attention. He is sweet, funny, and seems to care about student success. You will probably be learning it all yourself though. Exams are just like the practice and there is extra credit. There is no room for failing grades though.
He is one of the most amazing professors I had! He explains the content very well and in a very exciting way! Homework in this class is super easy and manageable.
Good lecturer

He is the most interesting professor I've had! He talks at a good pace and explains everything on the slides well. His slide outlines make studying very quick and easy. He also puts pictures and videos in his slides that are very funny. The workload is light, but the labs have the most work. Definitely study the practice tests prior to exams!

Dr. Xie is amazing! He is so funny and a great teacher that explains everything extremely well. He is very accomodating and the homeworks arent too difficult. Extra credit Iclickers weekly, and as long as you study you will do fine. 12/10!
Runshi Xie is super boring and everything you learn is on the slides. I literally only came for iClicker points, I did not need to attend this class at all

Runshi Xie is a nice guy, but he's one of the most dull teachers I've ever had in my entire life. Nothing we do in class is useful, everything can be learned from the slides, but you should still go to get iClicker points

He is a nice person but isn't good at teaching. He rushes through the content and basically reads off the slides. When it comes to questions, he would get annoyed if you don't understand what he considers "simple" concepts. However, the extra credit is insane (highly recommend going to his class just for iclicker). Probably why I got an A lol.
He is the most boring man I have ever met in my entire life. I never showed up to class, but you're forced to, to get iClicker points. Don't show up, just study outside and you can get an A

He's really cool when it comes with extra credit but other than that he's bad at teaching. He is accessible outside of class like office hour but my experience with him wasn't as helpful as I thought it would be. He seems to get annoyed easily when ask about a specific topic that he expect us to know even when he hasn't gone over it thoroughly.

You can tell that he was new to teaching. He didn't explain concepts well and read off the slides. When questions were asked, he seemed almost offended and never answered them adequately. The workload was definitely manageable, and he gave some extra credit. Just be prepared to teach yourself the material. The textbook and mock exams will help!

Dr. Xie doesn't really know how to explain concepts and responds to questions condescendingly so be ready to teach yourself everything. The extra credit is very helpful but all bio teachers offer the same amount. Practice exams are similar to exams, studying those will help a lot. Not a great experience but if you put the work in it is doable.

Get ready to teach yourself EVERYTHING before exams .I always resorted to the textbook instead of his slides, he sometimes does not know what he is talking about and if you ask questions be prepared to be even MORE confused from his answers. He is very nice though, and gives bonus points by Iclicker so attend class! Practice exams are very helpful.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Bio 111 is the easiest 4 credit class you will ever take. Dr.Xie is certainly new but does his best. Exams are just like the practice exams he releases. Do that and review the lecture sides and you will get an A. Labs were easy too.

Dr. Xie is a very nice guy. However, as a teacher, there is much to be desired. While his tests are somewhat taken from the practice exams, you must teach yourself EVERYTHING. He is incredibly hard to follow during lecture, reads off of the slides, and fails to explain difficult concepts. Do not take unless you are prepared to be your own teacher.

He's a nice guy but it's his first year teaching so his lecturing is not strong at all. He mumbles through most lectures and reads off of slides. Even if you decide to go to class for the extra credit you'll probably end up reteaching yourself the entire material before the exam. Kind of unclear when answering questions too. But still passable!

I absolutely loved this class with Dr. Xie. He takes lots of student feedback and works to make sure everyone understands the material. I found his lectures engaging and his practice questions helped on the exams (a little hard but manageable). I'm taking him next semester! He teaches off of his slides, so if you miss class, take notes from them.

He's a good teacher! And really cares about his students. He also gives practice exams and lots of other materials that you can use to study for the exams. Although this is his first year teaching he's doing a good job. I get the material fast even if you don't pay attention in class. Definitely would recommend him for Bio 111!

Well, I will start off by saying he is clearly a new teacher and a very nice guy. However, he is difficult to understand and talks too fast to even take notes. Be prepared to teach yourself the entire unit before each exam, because you will not learn anything from lecture. Thankfully, he does take iclicker for lots of extra credit points, show up!

It was tough to understand him during lectures and kinda hard to pay attention. He would barely talk about the concept on his slides and then move on to the next slide before you could write anything down, and they're hard to understand. He doesn't review before the exams. He also expects you to know something and then won't explain that thing.
